publishedfiledetails.title: Fast Travel(skined home sign)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4SP7fDb/Steam-2024-5-27-21-33-33.png[/img]

[hr]

English is available. The mod will choose your default language.

2025/1/2 update:

1. The sign's name could show above the sign. you could turn it on/off at setting menu.
2. Delay teleport function added. You could turn it on or off at setting menu. 
3. reworked some skin animation. 

1. Transactions rework.
2. Now you can choose turn/ off the light at mod setting menu .
3. Add revive function. Haunting the wood sign as a ghost revives players.You can choose to turn it on/off at setting menu.
4. Hunger cost and San cost are able to adjust at mod setting menu.
5. Able to be use with other teleportation mod together. 

Thank you all for like it. Sorry abt the late update. Hopefully you guys will enjoy this update! Have fun and happy international Women's Day ! 

[hr]


💗what does the mod do：

A teleportation sign to help player fast travel. the sign has 10 skins. The DST home sign also can do fast travel, you can turn it on at setting menu.

1. Now you can choose turn/ off the light at mod setting menu .
2. Add revive function. Haunting the wood sign as a ghost revives players.You can choose to turn it on/off at setting menu.
3. Hunger cost and San cost are able to adjust at mod setting menu.
4. Able to be use with other teleportation mod together. 

💗how to make：

travel cost hungry, the sign made of a wood board. you can find the sign from light, decorate, mod tab

💗reference：

Isosurface
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=458587300&searchtext=fast+travel


💗Recommend my other mods：
